turns.content: For a uniform self-gravitating sphere of mass M and radius R, how does the gravitational self-energy scale? Numerical profile factors may be omitted.
What continuum-mechanics relation converts this self-energy into an inward bulk-pressure scale? State it before applying it.
Using V=4 pi R^3/3, carry the relation or procedure selected above into an M-and-R scaling; if an energy derivative is used, state how dV/dR scales.
Combine the preceding scalings to obtain the M and R dependence of the resulting bulk quantity.
For a relativistic-electron cloud in equilibrium, what M and R dependence must the balancing ground-state pressure have?
Check the dimensions of the pressure scaling obtained from the energy or force model adopted above.
State the final pressure scaling, omitting only numerical profile factors.
